headline: Trane Technologies (TT) Stock Looks Reasonable Rather Than Cheap Today
summary: Trane Technologies stock has delivered a strong 156.0% return over the past 5 years, and at around US$483.34 per share the current market price now sits close to its intrinsic value estimate from a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model, while the broader valuation checks suggest the shares are not an obvious bargain. headline: Trane Technologies (TT) Faces Fresh Valuation Questions After Supply Chain Chief Exit
summary: Executive change at Trane Technologies sets the stage for fresh investor scrutiny Trane Technologies (TT) recently announced that Senior Vice President and Chief Global Integrated Supply Chain Officer Mingxiao Guo will leave the company on August 1, 2026, under a Separation Agreement. The company stated that Guo's departure does not stem from any disagreement over operations, policies or financial controls, which gives investors a clearer context as they assess what this leadership change...
